summary: Fix the constant shift when a pinch starts. A wrapper's offsetTop is relative to .reader (position:fixed, so it includes the toolbar and the container padding) while box.scrollTop is the scroll offset inside #readerPages; mixing them produced a constant error applied at the first gesture event, which then persisted because both phases used the same wrong formula. All positioning now goes through contentTopOf() (getBoundingClientRect difference plus scrollTop), and no raw offsetTop reads remain.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit cb29110. Reader UI only; no model call.

budget_impact.rationale: UI coordinate-system fix only; no model call, no operation or ceiling change.
budget_impact.before: A pinch shifted the view by a fixed amount at once (toolbar + padding), and it stayed; 适宽 jumped for the same reason.
budget_impact.after: All positioning uses scroll-content coordinates, so the anchor is exact at gesture start, during and on release.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting
